title: Mold Remediation Lead-Safe Work, Asbestos Sampling and Minimum Job Charge
content:
Lead-safe setup is billable only for housing built before the RRP year-built cutoff where painted surfaces are disturbed, and asbestos sampling only for buildings built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff, sampled before any drywall, texture or insulation removal. When the job's total of scope, equipment and clearance charges is below the tier's minimum job charge at invoicing, one minimum charge line for the shortfall is booked. These rules apply to every Mold Remediation tier.

## Lead-safe setup

Both conditions must hold for the line to be billable:

| Built before the RRP cutoff | Painted surfaces disturbed | Lead-safe setup billable |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Asbestos sampling

Asbestos sampling is billable only for a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff, and the sampling takes place before any drywall, texture or insulation removal.

## Minimum job charge

- The test is made at invoicing, on the job's total of scope, equipment and clearance charges.
- When that total is below the tier's minimum job charge, one minimum charge line is booked for the shortfall, that is, the minimum job charge less the total.
- When the total equals or exceeds the minimum job charge, no minimum charge line is booked.

Worked example, hypothetical figures: a job's scope, equipment and clearance charges total 930.40 at invoicing on a tier whose minimum job charge is 1250.00. One minimum charge line of 319.60 is booked. Had the total been 1250.00 exactly, it would not be below the minimum and no line would be booked.
